Ratio Formulas Used:
1. Current Ratio = Total Current Assets / Total Current Liabilities
2. Debt to Equity = Total Current Liabilities / Total Equity
3. Net Profit Margin = Profit After Tax / Total Revenue
4. Return on Assets (ROA) = Profit After Tax / Total Assets
5. Return on Equity (ROE) = Profit After Tax / Total Equity
6. EBITDA Margin = EBITDA / Total Revenue
7. Gross Margin = Gross Profit / Total Revenue
8. Operating Margin = Operating Income / Total Revenue
